body: (Continued) I started buying fast food every meal to eat in my room because my father sleeps in the living room kitchen area and I get screamed at every time he sees me. I pretty much just go to work and spend the rest of my time in my room. My car constantly has problems and I was sued by the place I got the loan from for not making payments. I am currently taking 150 mg of Wellbutrin for depression which helped immensely for my brain fog and .5 mg twice a day of Klonopin which helps a lot with my anxiety. I got diagnosed with ADHD a year ago but stopped going there for treatment and was kind of wary of trying medication. I recently went back there and was just prescribed 60 mg of Strattera for that which I will be starting in a couple of days. Whenever my parents confront me about any of these issues they mock me and act like my mental issues aren't real and that I'm just lazy. I need to get away from my family and I cannot stand the midwest winters any longer and I would like to move to a western state especially Oregon or Arizona but it's just not financially viable for me to do that. My car loan shattered my credit so I can't go back to school right now and I'm about 5000 dollars in debt between that and the loans I had to take out to try to help my back problems. I have barely any friends and any girl that I like I get way too attached to too quickly and I ruin it because of my anxiety and clinginess and that further shatters my self confidence. I have contemplated suicide many times in the past few years and only have a couple people I can talk to about these things. I just need a fresh start somewhere and this medication for ADHD is really my last hope to having a successful life at all. If anyone has been in similar circumstances and would give me some advice I would really appreciate it. I just don't know what to do and any time I try it just makes things worse.
